The 2021 Chrysler Pacifica comes with an assertive new look and an available
All-Wheel-Drive (AWD) system for enhanced driving capability. The new
Pacifica brings athletic new fascias and grille, a new premium trim level with
luxury interior, and compatible new technologies. The redesigned lineup
offers the innovative Pacifica Plug-in Hybrid with combined gas and
all-electric power and boasts the most standard safety features in the
industry2 to help make every ride more secure.
*A note about this brochure: all disclosures can be found on the last page.

V I S I O N A R Y AC H I E V E M E N T
The sculpted new Chrysler Pacifica is highlighted by distinctive accents and badging on the new PinnacleTM with Platinum Chrome exterior finishes
and 20-inch wheels. Available on gas and hybrid models, the top-of-the-line Pinnacle trim level speaks volumes about Pacifica’s upscale pedigree.
